column1: WHEREAS the office of member of Valvettithurai Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;
And whereas the Secretary of the All Ceylon Tamil Congress, the recognized political party to which Appulingam
Uthayasuriyan the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A(l)(a) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon
the member of that Valvettithurai Urban Council of ward number 05 Valvettithurai who belongs to such party and is not
disqualified under section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected
as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate
Mahalingam Kanakalingam Sivajilingam to fill such vacancy;
Therefore I, Rajendra Saseelan, Returning Officer of the Valvettithurai Urban Council, acting in terms of section
66A(l)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mahalingam Kanakalingam
Sivajilingam was elected as the member of the ward number 05 Valvettithurai of Valvettithurai Urban Council.
